companyDescription: AI cloud infrastructure (ex-Bitcoin miner) · $2.8B of multi-year contracts covering 85% of a $4B 2026 ARR target, with Microsoft and NVIDIA among the customers
priceNote: Live price Aug 13 07:49, up 9.86% today alone. Prior report (Aug 4) used $39.75 — +9.9% drift in 9 days. The stock now sits 30.4% above the $32-35 entry zone, the widest gap of any BUY-rated name on the board.
sector: Technology / AI Infrastructure & Data Centers (ex-Bitcoin Mining)
summary: The transition thesis is now largely proven rather than promised: IREN has secured $2.8B in new multi-year contracts covering 85% of its $4B 2026 ARR target, with Microsoft and NVIDIA among the named customers, and plans 480MW of AI cloud capacity in 2026 rising to 1.2GW in 2027. That is a different company from the Bitcoin miner the ticker used to represent. Consensus is $75.18 (range $46-$100; a 16-analyst S&P set reads higher at $81.73), so upside is +72% or better and the rating split is 62% Strong Buy. The problem is entirely the entry: after a 9.86% move today the stock trades 30.4% above its preferred zone, going into Q4 FY2026 earnings on Aug 27.

catalysts.name: Q4 FY2026 Earnings
catalysts.description: First print where the AI cloud contracts should show as recognised revenue rather than announced backlog. The number to watch is contracted ARR conversion and whether the 480MW 2026 delivery target holds its schedule.

catalysts.name: Additional Hyperscaler / AI-Developer Contracts
catalysts.description: With 85% of the $4B ARR target already covered, further contract wins push into 2027's 1.2GW plan. Announcement-driven and undated — each one has re-rated the stock this cycle.

risks: 30.4% above the preferred entry zone after a 9.86% single-day move — the single worst entry on the board among BUY-rated names
Analyst dispersion is enormous ($46 low to $100 high, a 2.2x spread) and 8% of analysts rate it Sell — the market has not agreed on what this business is worth
Capacity buildout from 480MW to 1.2GW is capital-intensive and execution-dependent; a schedule slip hits the ARR path directly
Customer concentration in a handful of hyperscalers means one contract renegotiation moves the whole thesis
Residual Bitcoin exposure still links the equity to crypto sentiment independent of the AI cloud story
Buying 14 days ahead of earnings at a 52-week-range extreme is the setup the measured -14% median MAE was built to warn about

estimateDates.note: 1.2GW plan — the number funding the bull case

macroRisk.rateOutlook: Fed funds 3.50-3.75%, held Jul 29 with three dissents for a hike. Next FOMC Sep 16, after IREN's Aug 27 print.
macroRisk.inflationNote: July CPI (Aug 12) headline 3.4% from 3.5%, core 2.5%, +0.1% m/m — soft enough to reduce hike odds after a -23k payrolls print.
macroRisk.sectorImpact: Data-centre buildout is capital-intensive and financed, so rates feed directly into the cost of the 1.2GW plan. The residual crypto exposure adds a second, separate rate/liquidity channel that a pure AI infrastructure name wouldn't carry.
macroRisk.summary: MEDIUM — capital intensity plus residual crypto beta gives this more rate sensitivity than its AI-infrastructure framing suggests.

entryStrategy.verdict: Best fundamental story on the board, worst entry on the board — wait for $36-38.5 rather than chase 30% above zone into an Aug 27 print.

catalystSpot.preRunup: The pre-earnings run has already happened and then some — up 9.9% in nine days including 9.86% today, on contract news rather than the earnings itself. Feedback prior's earnings_beat bucket (n=42, medianExcessVsBenchPct +1.8 vs +1.4 overall) is neither leader nor laggard, so no tier-2 adjustment applies.
catalystSpot.preRunupTiming: 2-3 สัปดาห์ก่อนงบ

postWin.note: Direct sector comparables on AI-datacenter pivot news: WULF +22% (Oct 2025), CIFR +19% (Nov 2025), and IREN's own +20% (Jul 2026). Consistent clustering around +20%.

postLose.note: Miner-to-AI names give back the re-rating quickly when contracted revenue slips, and IREN is priced 30% above its own entry zone, which raises the give-back on a disappointment.

spotSizing.reason: Held at 3% despite the improved fundamentals. The contract news genuinely de-risks the thesis, but entering 30.4% above zone into earnings offsets it — conviction in the business does not justify sizing up at this price.

stopPreCatalyst.note: A break here before Aug 27 means the contract-driven re-rating is being given back

stopPostCatalyst.note: If contracted ARR conversion disappoints, exit — the multiple rests entirely on that conversion

comparableCases.note: Same ticker, same catalyst family, one month ago — establishes the +20% response size for contract news and shows the market is already paying for this story.
Closest structural analogue — a Bitcoin miner repricing as AI infrastructure on a hyperscaler contract. Magnitude matches IREN's own response.
Third instance of the same pattern within a month of WULF, confirming ~+20% is the sector's response size rather than a one-off.

th.summary: Thesis เรื่องการเปลี่ยนผ่านตอนนี้พิสูจน์แล้วเป็นส่วนใหญ่ ไม่ใช่แค่คำสัญญา — IREN ได้สัญญาระยะยาวใหม่มูลค่า $2.8B ครอบคลุม 85% ของเป้า ARR $4B ปี 2026 โดยมี Microsoft และ NVIDIA อยู่ในรายชื่อลูกค้า และวางแผนกำลังการผลิต AI cloud 480MW ในปี 2026 เพิ่มเป็น 1.2GW ในปี 2027 · นี่คือคนละบริษัทกับเหมือง Bitcoin ที่ ticker นี้เคยเป็น · consensus อยู่ที่ $75.18 (ช่วง $46-$100 · ชุด 16 นักวิเคราะห์ของ S&P อ่านสูงกว่าที่ $81.73) upside จึงเป็น +72% ขึ้นไป และเรตติ้ง 62% เป็น Strong Buy · ปัญหาอยู่ที่จุดเข้าล้วน ๆ: หลังวิ่ง 9.86% วันนี้ หุ้นอยู่สูงกว่าโซนที่ต้องการถึง 30.4% และกำลังจะเจองบ Q4 FY2026 วันที่ 27 ส.ค.
